work-with-us.title: Work With Us – Careers and Supplier Partnerships
work-with-us.description: Build your career at HYT Engineering or supply the components behind our CNC wheel lathes. Explore careers, supplier registration and life at HYT in Pune.
work-with-us.lede: The machines we build keep trains running safely for decades. Whether you join our team or supply the parts we build with, you share in that responsibility.
work-with-us.summary: Careers, supplier registration and life at HYT – ways to build railway machines with us.

blocks.heading: Work that you can see running on the tracks
paragraphs: At HYT, an engineer can follow a machine from the first layout sketch to the day it re-profiles its first wheelset in a depot. We design, build, install and service our own machines, so the people who work here see the whole life of the product – and the effect their work has on the railways that use it.
We have built machine tools in Pune since 1977. That history means experienced colleagues to learn from, alongside the modern CNC, measuring and drive technology that today's railways expect.
bullets: Real responsibility on machines for railways and metros in India and abroad
Learning from colleagues with decades of wheel lathe experience
Work across design, manufacturing, site commissioning and service
Management systems certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001

blocks.heading: Why suppliers grow with HYT
blocks.intro: Our machines depend on reliable castings, fabrications, electrical systems and services. We look for partners who want a long-term relationship, not a single order.

items.title: Long-term programmes
items.text: Machines and spare parts are supplied over many years, so good suppliers become part of a continuing programme.

items.title: Clear requirements
items.text: Drawings, specifications and inspection criteria agreed before production starts.

items.title: Fair and responsible dealing
items.text: Transparent processes guided by our [Code of Conduct](page:code-of-conduct).

blocks.heading: Ready to take the next step?
blocks.text: Send us your application or register your company. We read every submission and reply when there is a suitable opportunity.

career.title: Careers at HYT Engineering, Pune

career.lede: Design, build and service the machines that keep railway wheels safe. We look for people who take pride in precise work and want to see it in service.
career.summary: Why join HYT, the areas you can work in, how our hiring works and how to apply.

items.title: The whole product life
items.text: Design, manufacture, commissioning and service under one roof – see the full picture, not one fragment.

items.title: Learning on the job
items.text: Work alongside experienced engineers and technicians, with structured training on our machines.

items.title: Projects in India and abroad

items.title: Room to grow
items.text: Responsibility comes early for people who show ownership and care.

items.title: Apply
items.text: Send the form with your CV. Tell us which role or area interests you.

items.title: Review
items.text: Our HR team and the hiring manager review your application against the role.

items.title: Interview
items.text: Shortlisted candidates meet the team – in person in Pune or online – and may complete a technical discussion or test.

items.title: Offer
items.text: Successful candidates receive a written offer setting out role, terms and joining date.

items.title: Induction
items.text: Your first weeks include safety induction, an introduction to our machines and time with your team.

blocks.heading: Apply to HYT
blocks.intro: Tell us about yourself and attach your CV as a PDF. We reply to applicants whose profile matches a current or upcoming role.

supplier-registration.title: Supplier Registration
supplier-registration.description: Register to supply HYT Engineering with castings, machined parts, fabrications, electrical and CNC systems, hydraulics or services for railway machine tools.
supplier-registration.lede: Every HYT machine is only as reliable as its parts. We welcome capable suppliers who share our standards for quality, delivery and responsible business.
supplier-registration.summary: Register your company to supply components, systems or services to HYT Engineering.

blocks.heading: Supply categories
blocks.intro: We source a wide range of materials, components and services for our wheel lathes, wheel and axle shop machines, depot equipment and turnkey projects.

blocks.heading: What we look for in a supplier

items.title: Quality
items.text: Parts that meet drawing and specification every time, with inspection records and traceability where required.

items.title: Delivery
items.text: Realistic commitments and early warning if a date is at risk. Our project schedules depend on yours.

items.title: Documentation
items.text: Test certificates, material certificates and manuals supplied with the goods, complete and correct.

items.title: Safety and environment
items.text: Safe working practices and responsible environmental management, in line with our ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 systems.

items.title: Compliance
items.text: Ethical, lawful business in line with our [Code of Conduct](page:code-of-conduct) and statutory requirements.

items.title: Communication
items.text: A named contact, quick responses and open discussion when problems arise.

items.title: Register
items.text: Complete the form below with your company details, supply categories and certifications.

items.title: Review
items.text: Our purchasing team reviews your profile against our current and planned requirements.

items.title: Assessment
items.text: Where there is a match, we may request documents, samples or a visit to your facility.

items.title: Approval
items.text: Approved suppliers are added to our vendor list for the relevant categories.

items.title: Enquiries and orders
items.text: You receive enquiries when a requirement matches your capabilities. Performance is reviewed regularly.

blocks.heading: Register your company
blocks.intro: Registration does not guarantee an enquiry or an order, but it ensures our purchasing team knows your capabilities when a requirement arises.

memorialization.title: Life at HYT
memorialization.description: Life at HYT Engineering beyond the shop floor: annual meets, safety weeks, blood donation camps, Yoga Day and the moments our team in Pune shares together.
memorialization.lede: Our machines are built by people. These are some of the moments we share as a team – at work, for our health and safety, and with our community.
memorialization.summary: Annual meets, safety weeks, blood donation camps and Yoga Day – the people behind HYT's machines.

blocks.heading: More than a workplace
paragraphs: Precision machines need people who care about details – and people care more when they feel part of a team. Throughout the year, colleagues from design, the shop floor, service and the office come together for events that have nothing to do with deadlines.

Our annual meet brings everyone together to celebrate the year's work. Safety week reminds us that every machine we build is built safely. Blood donation camps and our [community initiatives](page:csr) let us give something back, and International Yoga Day is a chance to look after ourselves.
blocks.image_alt: Sample illustration of HYT colleagues gathered at a company event

items.title: Annual meet
items.text: The whole team in one place to look back on the year and celebrate the work of colleagues.

items.title: Safety week
items.text: Talks, drills and shop-floor activities that keep safe working habits fresh for everyone.

items.title: Blood donation camp
items.text: Colleagues volunteer to donate blood for patients who need it.

items.title: International Yoga Day
items.text: A shared session on 21 June that puts health and well-being first.
